summary: Three-CLI transfer task using 8,277 real US export customs records across Dongying, Zibo, and Guangzhou regions. The agent must aggregate by supplier, apply tiered qualification thresholds (Priority A/B/C), and build a cross-system trade finance pipeline across DWS (structured report with blocks, folder, sub-reports, collaboration), Stripe (customers, products per HS chapter, invoices with line items, tax rates, coupons), and Todoist (priority sections, supplier tasks with lifecycle management). Cross-system traceability requires Stripe customer IDs in Todoist task content.
check_strategy: Verifier reads only final dws/stripe/todoist states over verifier-only endpoints. It checks supplier qualification against real CSV aggregation, DWS document/folder/block structure, Stripe customer/invoice/product state, Todoist project/section/task placement and lifecycle, and cross-system Stripe ID references in Todoist tasks. It does not inspect command history.

checks.description: All three mock states are reachable and contain the expected project/document containers.
DWS has analysis folder, main report document, three regional sub-reports moved to folder, comments, permissions for team, uploaded CSV files, and exported document.
DWS main report blocks contain correct supplier aggregation data (supplier name, priority, amounts, shipments) for each of the 12 qualified suppliers.
Stripe has exactly 12 customer records matching qualified supplier names with correct priority/region metadata.
Stripe has products per HS chapter, prices at correct unit amount, tax rates per region, and the volume discount coupon.
Stripe has one draft invoice per qualified supplier with correct line items and description.
Todoist project has exactly 4 sections with correct names, supplier tasks placed in correct priority sections with right content/priority/labels, completed setup task, and demonstrated reopen flow.
Todoist supplier task content includes Stripe customer ID references.
Original CSV files remain present and parseable with correct row counts.

notes: Ground truth is held in private/expected_answer.json. 12 qualified suppliers across 3 priority tiers, derived from real customs data aggregation.
